components.name: Label Row
components.description: The shelf label: fixed amount column, name, one secondary line, trailing tick ring. One tap takes the item.
components.css: .ds-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; background: #e9ecef; font-family: Rubik, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-label-row { display: flex; align-items: stretch; min-height: 60px; width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,22,26,0.08); color: #14161a; font: inherit; text-align: start; transition: opacity 120ms ease-out; } .ds-label-row:active { opacity: 0.65; } .ds-label-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14161a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-col { display: flex; flex: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 58px; border-inline-end: 1px solid #e3e6ea; } .ds-num { font-size: 1.625rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-unit { margin-top: 2px; color: #555a61; font-size: 0.6875rem; } .ds-body { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 12px; } .ds-text { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; } .ds-name { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-sec { margin-top: 2px; color: #555a61; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-warn { color: #b3261e; font-weight: 500; } .ds-ring { display: grid; place-items: center; box-sizing: border-box; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 2px solid #14161a; border-radius: 50%; color: #14161a; } .ds-ring.is-ticked { background: #ffd21f; } .ds-label-row.is-taken { background: #dde1e5; box-shadow: none; color: #5a5f66; } .ds-label-row.is-taken .ds-name { text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-label-row.is-taken .ds-col { border-inline-end-color: #cdd2d7; } .ds-label-row.is-taken .ds-unit { color: #5a5f66; }

components.css: .ds-ground { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; background: #e9ecef; font-family: Rubik, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-choices { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-choice { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; color: #14161a; font: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: opacity 120ms ease-out; } .ds-choice[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #ffd21f; font-weight: 500; } .ds-choice:active, .ds-seg-choice:active { opacity: 0.65; } .ds-choice:focus-visible, .ds-seg-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14161a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; grid-auto-flow: column; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 14px; background: #dde1e5; } .ds-seg-choice { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: transparent; color: #555a61; font: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-seg-choice[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,22,26,0.08); color: #14161a; font-weight: 500; }

components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-top: 1px solid #e3e6ea; background: #ffffff; font-family: Rubik, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 0 6px; color: #555a61; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 120ms ease-out; } .ds-tab::before { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 50%; width: 24px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; content: ''; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-tab.is-selected { color: #14161a; } .ds-tab.is-selected::before { background: #ffd21f; } .ds-tab:active { opacity: 0.65; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14161a; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Every item is the label on a supermarket shelf edge: a white card on a cool grey shelf, the amount to take set big in a fixed column where the price would be, and the lesson from last time on one line under the name. The system is built for a phone held in one hand in a shop aisle, so it reads in one glance down a single column of numerals, and one tap anywhere on a label takes the item.

The screens are calm and standard iOS underneath: Ionic iOS navigation, back buttons, sheets and a four-tab bar stay native. The world lives in the labels, in heavy Rubik numerals, and in one sale-tag yellow that only ever marks "this is the number that matters" or "this one is done". There is no costume: no paper texture, no price-tag die-cut, no patterns or dashed lines. Hebrew RTL throughout, with numerals isolated LTR and tabular.
keyCharacteristics: White rounded labels (14px) on a cool grey ground, 8px apart, one soft shadow.
A fixed 58px amount column with a divider on every row, so amounts line up down the screen.
Rubik at three weights only (400, 500, 800); 800 for numerals and titles.
One accent, sale-tag yellow, always carrying ink on top of it.
Taken is grey, struck through and ticked, never colour alone.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Anything yellow carries ink (#14161a) text or strokes; yellow never carries white and never appears as text colour.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks either the one number that matters on the screen or a done/selected state. It is not used for decoration, headings or borders.

rules.name: The Red Is A Word Rule
rules.body: Warning red is text only: a verdict, a "לא היה" mark, an error or a destructive action label. No red fills, badges or borders.

rules.name: The One Big Numeral Rule
rules.body: Each screen has at most one display numeral; every other number is a row numeral or body size.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400, 500 and 800 are loaded. Do not ask for 600 or 700.

rules.name: The Isolated Numeral Rule
rules.body: Numbers and prices sit in an LTR-isolated, tabular span inside RTL text.

rules.name: The Taken Sinks Rule
rules.body: A taken label loses its shadow, takes the taken grey and moves below the waiting ones; it never floats.

dos: Do put every list item in a label row with the fixed amount column, even when the amount is empty, so the column stays aligned.
Do keep the screen to one display numeral and one yellow focus.
Do mark state with a shape or a word as well as colour: struck through and ticked for taken, the words "לא היה" and "לא לקנות שוב" in red.
Do use solid filled SVG icons (`fill: currentColor`) at 16–30px.
Do keep 44px minimum tap targets and a 16px gutter on every screen.
Do put new screens on the shelf-grey ground with white 14–20px rounded blocks and native Ionic iOS navigation.
donts: Don't put white text on yellow, or use yellow for headings, borders or decoration.
Don't use warning red as a fill, badge or border.
Don't add paper texture, price-tag costume, patterns, dotted or dashed lines, or ornamental bands.
Don't let a row wrap to a second secondary line; truncate and move the long text to the item page.
Don't use font weights other than 400, 500 and 800.
Don't put a decorative kicker or eyebrow above a title; a small line above a number is allowed only when it is data (the spending period).
